entries.back_en: You want to go to the capital? The only one around here who's ever been there is the Old Man. That's what everyone calls him. He lives in the tent over there.
entries.note: Initial 'What?' omitted; 'Gramps' rendered 'Velhinho', acceptable. Meaning intact.

entries.back_en: Hmm...In that case, the quickest way is to go east and pass through the gate at Kwanso... But you might not be able to get through now...
Well...There's the First Emperor's Tomb to the northeast...
Hmm...All right, no matter. But be careful--the Tomb is haunted! No one knows what kinds of monsters are there!
I was trying to make a fence to keep the Old Man's chickens in, but they were too fast and ran off... If you go to the Western Plains, you can probably still catch up with them.
I remember I'd gone to the Emperor's Tomb to catch some monsters to sell in Astana... That's when I found that road.
I've heard there's something going on in the capital, and that they're going to close all the gates.
